[[Elves]] can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at level 70 [[Combat level|combat]] by various [[Slayer masters]] after completion of [[Regicide]]. Elves either use ranged or melee, depending on their weapon; wielding either a [[crystal bow]] or a [[crystal halberd]], of which the latter has an attack range of 2 tiles.

Until the player has access to [[Lletya]], the only place for them to kill elves is the [[Iorwerth Camp]]. Reaching the camp can be very tedious without using an [[Iorwerth camp teleport]],  and players intending to use a [[dwarf multicannon]] are discouraged from doing so as the camp is impeded by tents, barrels, and crates. Players may prefer [[Reanimated elf|reanimating elves]] using the [[Arceuus spellbook]] spell [[Adept Reanimation]] at the [[Dark Altar]], the [[Ensouled elf head|ensouled heads]] being purchasable through the Grand Exchange, and gaining 754 Prayer experience per kill but gaining less Slayer and combat experience.

Once enough progress is made in [[Mourning's End Part I]], players can kill elves in both [[Lletya]] and [[Mourner Headquarters]]. As with the Iorwerth Camp, getting to Lletya can be tedious, and the elves of Lletya have no notable drops other than [[Crystal teleport seed]]s. As for the Mourner Headquarters, only the level 108 [[mourner]]s downstairs will count toward the task, and cannot be reached without a full set of [[mourner gear]]; the mourners upstairs do not count toward the task, despite all of them being elves.

After completing [[Song of the Elves]], players gain access to [[Prifddinas]] and, most notably, the [[Iorwerth Dungeon]]. The dungeon contains 13 [[Iorwerth Warrior]]s and allows the use of a cannon. The elves in Prifddinas (and the warriors in the dungeon) can drop [[crystal shard]]s and [[enhanced crystal teleport seed]]s, which sell for a good price on the Grand Exchange. However, given their lower weight from higher-levelled slayer masters and the seed being a bit rare, players are recommended to skip elf tasks when they get the chance.

[[File:Iorwerth Warrior (Iorwerth Dungeon) safespot.png|thumb|right|A player attacks an elf from a safespot.]]

===Exceptions===
* [[Mourner]]s at any level other than 108 do not count towards a Slayer task.
* The [[elven traitor]], [[Essyllt]], and all other elves fought during [[Song of the Elves]] do not count towards a Slayer task either.

==Safespots==
[[Safespotting]] can be done with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]]. Elves can be safespotted in [[Lletya]] and [[Iorwerth Dungeon]] as shown below. For the Iorwerth dungeon safespot, simply attack the [[Elf warrior]] while they are on the other side of the red line from you and go into the safespot, they should trap themselves.
